analysis_reference_motion_threshold: 0.05 m/s OR 22 deg/s, 7-frame median; valid bout >=100 ms and >=5 mm or >=5 deg excursion
visible_response_definition: First 100 ms sustained display displacement >5 mm or >3 deg from pre-onset 500 ms median pose
settling_definition: Earliest 500 ms window with position P95 spread <=2 mm and rotation P95 spread <=1 deg
